name: Mitchell Linn
source:
Mitchell Linn... prestigious pundit of the palate, master of the mouthwatering morsel, destroyer of the deviant dining establishment... He is obsessed by all things culinary: a true believer in the power of a great meal to give meaning to an otherwise drab and dreary life (so he sees it). Detail-oriented, and utterly unsparing, Mitchell leaves nothing out of his withering critiques. Ambiance, service, menu selection, flavor, presentation: all are of the utmost importance to Mitchell. And if any are sub par? Well, you're going to know about it. With the pen as his sword, he is ready to elevate or eviscerate with equal fervor.
Likes: High-Quality Products and Ingredients, Careful Balance of Flavor Profiles, Consistency of Service 
Dislikes: Cronuts

[From the in-game Date-a-dex]
